newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Chugoku Electric dlr, mark bonds.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Chugoku Electric dlr, mark bonds.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Monday it had assigned its AA rating to Chugoku Electric Power Co Inc's $250 million 6.25 percent bond due December 11, 2001 and 300 million mark 5.625 percent bond due December 12, 2003.
"The rating outlook is stable," S&P said in a statement.

"Chugoku is expected to continue to benefit from a highly stable operating environment, underpinned by continued regulatory oversight by the Ministry of International Trade and Industry," the rating agency said.
S&P said the rating reflected Chugoku's very strong business position as the monopoly provider of electricity in Japan's Chugoku region and acceptable level of financial risk for the rating category.
